name: IntegrateIT OpenAI Assistant
notes: Ask the OpenAI Platform API from Control4 programming: an Ask command sends a prompt (parameter or property) to chat completions with a configurable model, system prompt, and max-token cap, publishes the answer to a bounded RESPONSE variable, and fires Response Ready / Request Failed / Rate Limit Reached events. Strict per-request timeout with stale-response discard, a per-hour request cap enforced before any network call, and a BYO-key design: the customer enters their own OpenAI API key, sent only in the request header and never logged.
